title: Cisco Nexus 9000 Series NX-OS Release Notes, Release 10.1(2)

observations.description: N9K-C93600CD-GX: Ports 1-24 : 40G/100G Copper has higher Link up time with Auto-Negotiation enabled Symptoms: N9K-C93600CD-GX: Ports 1-24 : 40G/100G Copper has higher Link up time with Auto-Negotiation enabled N9K-C9364C-GX : Ports 1-64: 40G/100G Copper has higher Link up time with Auto-Negotiation enabled Workarounds: There is no workaround. 40G and 100G Copper Links with Auto-Negoatiation enabled may take upto 28s to link up.

PVmap traffic loss seen with trigger Xconnect vlan removal/adddition Symptoms: When XConnect configuration is inconsistent between vPC VTEP peers while configuration is in progress and not yet complete, it causes STP churn and traffic issues on unrelated vlans. The issue is seen only under below circumstances VPC boxes are running in MST mode. Xconnect configuration is inconsistent between VPC peers. Xconnect access ports are up. After the configuration is completed/corrected on both sides of the VPC peers, the STP and traffic issues goes away. Workarounds: Keep the Xconnect ports in shut state on all VTEPs during configuring/unconfiguring Xconnect on the associated vlans. This is to make sure that switch does not receive customer STP BPDUs causing STP churn on unrelated vlan.

Xconnect vlan deletion/bringup via DME fails Symptoms: Configuring Xconnect along with vlan create and vn-segment mapping in a single request message via REST, does not enable xconnect. Workarounds: User can configure Xconnect in a separate REST message. Vlan create and vn-segment can be configured together in a single request.

10gx4 CLI breakout port not able to send DHCP Request & DHCPv6 NA & RA during POAP Symptoms: POAP v4 or POAP v4 may not be able to complete DHCP transaction. This is seen on the PID :- N9K-X9624D-R2 Line card POAP v4 will print below logs : 2021 May 11 06:11:55 switch %$ VDC-1 %$ %POAP-2-POAP_INFO: Recieved DHCP offer from server ip - 192.168.1.10 2021 May 11 06:13:04 switch %$ VDC-1 %$ %POAP-2-POAP_FAILURE: [FGE18480P4B-74:26:AC:FD:DE:FF] - POAP DHCP discover phase failed Workarounds: Below are few workarounds. 1. Flap the port on intermediate switch. 2. Directly connect the port to DHCP server. 3. Use a hardware breakout cable. 4. Avoid using software (cli) breakout. 5. Use Management port for POAP. 6. Use ipv6 POAP. 7. User any other port which doesn't require software breakout.

ECMP load-sharing not working w/ sRC/DST change but same labels with "mpls load-share label-ip" Symptoms: MPLS label traffic is not load-shared between ECMP member links based on inner header SRC/DST IP. When MPLS label is kept same and the IP variant is tested, load sharing does not happen between ECMP members. If outer header MPLS label changes, load sharing happens correctly Workarounds: If outer header MPLS Label changes load sharing will happen correctly. No work-around for IP variant load sharing

Config-replace using gNMI does not replace VNIs to range VNIs and range to sub-range VNIs Symptoms: JSON based config-replace cannot correctly replace VNI configurations for overlapping ranges. Workarounds: CLI based config-replace can be used to replace overlapping VNI configurations.

Intermittent Link Flaps observed with QSFP-100G-PSM4 Symptoms: Repeating flaps are seen on the links between Jericho linecard and Tahoe linecard, using CISCO-LUXTERA QSFP-100G-PSM4 rev B or C. The links recovers from the flap shortly and is stable for some time afterwards. Workarounds: NA

BUM traffic drop after NVE flap on vpc primary post SSO Symptoms: Vxlan BUM traffic drop on decapsulation on uplink interface on EOR with EX, FX and GX series of linecards Workarounds: Admin flap of the NVE interface after MRIB convergence state is set to "Done" 1) Execute "show routing multicast internal convergence vrf default" and ensure convergence state is "Done". 2) Execute the following commands: interface nve1 shut # Wait for approximately 120 secs for all decap routes to be withdrawn from the fib interface nve1 no shut

Single-strand UDE link failure in link flap Symptoms: Additional link flap observed before link comes up when UDE feature enabled with single strand connection Workarounds: Issue not observed with double strand connection
Revert reserved MAC blocking behavior for VRRP macs on SVIs Symptoms: User not able to configure VRRP VMAC on SVI interfaces. Workarounds: None.

Credit Loss Recovery is not triggered for FC interface with no transmit credits. Symptom: A Fibre Channel interface that stays at 0 transmit credits is not recovered by the Credit Loss Recovery agent. Workaround: If the interface has switchport ignore bit-errors configured, then remove it with the no switchport ignore bit-errors interface configuration command.

Custom COPP causing transit traffic to be punted to the CPU on Nexus 9300-GX2 Symptoms: When custom-COPP policy contains ACL rules which match on Layer 4 destination or source port, transit traffic also hits the COPP and the packets are copied to CPU. This causes duplication of traffic as CPU also routes the copied packets to the destination. Workarounds: Custom COPP policy using src/dst match mitigates punt for transit traffic.

[J:256]: MACs are not unfreezing from l2rib after MAC-Move stopped Symptoms: Few mac???s (10-20) out of 10K mac???s are stuck in "permanently frozen" state in L2RIB even after duplicate hosts are removed. Workarounds: clear mac address-table dynamic address

multicast traffic does not pass nexus 9300 when "layer-2 multicast lookup mac" is configured Symptoms: Multicast traffic does not pass through the switch Workarounds: remove below configuration command layer-2 multicast lookup mac

RFC6368: NXOS BGP does not push AS_PATH in ATTR_SET Symptoms: In VXLAN-EVPN topology with iBGP PE-CE configured on VTEPs, a non NXOS VTEP complains while performing "pop path attributes" explained in RFC6368 due to AS_PATH being absent in the ATTR_SET attribute. Workarounds: None.

Supporting RS FEC on N9K-X97160YC-EX Symptoms: When connecting a Nexus 9500 N9K-X97160YC-EX linecard to a Catalyst 9000 switch while utilizing a SFP-10/25G-LR-S transceiver, FEC auto negotiations fails and the link does not come up. This is seen at 25Gbe speeds and does not impact 10G speed if statically set. Workarounds: The port will come up if the speed is set to 10Gbe statically in the port configurations. This disables the need for FEC.

After adding invalid upgrade RPMS, installation of actual RPM fails Symptoms: The installation of upgrade RPM fails with the below error install add bgp-3.0.0.0.rpm activate Adding the patch (/bgp-3.0.0.0.rpm) [####################] 100% Install operation 393 completed successfully at Mon Apr 19 15:25:52 2021 Activating the patch (/bgp-3.0.0.0.rpm) Unable to find the location of added package Workarounds: Ensure that name of upgrade RPM is not changed while copying the RPM to the device

Thurn - nvram re-init may cause system crash during boot Symptoms: nvram re-init during boot can result in PCIE uncorrectable errors and subsequent system reload for N9K-C92348GC. Workarounds: The issue will resolve itself following 2 system reloads.
